# v3.34.0

Covers everything since **v3.33.1**.

This release is about **moving a training catalogue from one system to another** with Export and Import on **Admin > Training Data**. Before it, some entries stayed in "needs attention" however complete the file was, some classifications were overwritten with guesses, and legacy replacements could go missing. There is no database migration.

**If you have never exported a catalogue from one system and imported it into another, the fixes below are unlikely to have affected you.** The new count on the import results screen is available to everyone.

## Fixed — an import now clears "needs attention"

A student import that mentions a training the catalogue doesn't know creates it automatically and lists it under **"needs attention"** until someone picks its Type, Product and Function.

An import of catalogue data never cleared that state. A file that fully classified such an entry updated its Type, Product and Function, but the entry stayed in "needs attention" and stayed out of every report.

Now, when a row in the file supplies Type (or a Parent Training Title), Product and Function, a matching entry that is awaiting review is marked as done. The default values the import wizard offers for columns the file doesn't have never count as a classification.

## Fixed — the export no longer passes on guesses

An entry that is still awaiting review holds placeholder values in its Type, Product and Function. The export used to write those out as if someone had chosen them, so the system receiving the file treated them as real.

Those three cells are now **blank** for an entry awaiting review. On import, a blank cell means "not set":

- it never overwrites a classification the receiving system already has, and
- a new entry that arrives with a blank cell is placed in "needs attention" rather than being given a guess.

**If you have a catalogue file exported before this release, export it again.** An older file can't be told apart from a genuine classification.

## New — the import results show how many entries were reviewed

The results screen now includes a line saying how many entries the file took out of "needs attention". These entries are already counted in **Updated**, so the line is not an addition to the totals.

## Fixed — legacy replacements defined later in the file are kept

A legacy certification's **Replacement** column names the training that replaces it. If that replacement appeared further down the same file, the first import dropped it without a word. Importing the file a second time filled it in.

One import is now enough. A replacement that doesn't match any Certification or Accreditation in the catalogue is now listed in the import results, instead of disappearing silently.

## For administrators

**No database migration, and nothing to run by hand.** No existing data is changed by the update itself; the fixes apply the next time you import a catalogue file.

This is a minor release (`3.33.1` → `3.34.0`) because it adds the new count to the import results alongside the fixes.
